notFound.title: Clinic not found
notFound.hint: It does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

name.hintEmpty: No letters or digits in this name, so it will not appear in file names.
name.renameNote: A new name applies to recordings made after the change.
name.tooLong: The name can have at most 64 characters.

errors.invalidEmail: "{{email}}" is not a valid email address.
errors.invalidMicGain: Microphone gain must be a whole number from 0 to 100.

list.title: Clinics
list.sub: Where your studies run. All computers at a clinic share one access token and receive the same protocols.
list.emptyBody: A clinic is where a study runs. Create one to get an access token for its computers.
list.emptyBodyNoCreate: Ask an administrator to give you access to a clinic.

new.title: New clinic
new.desc: You will get an access token to enter in the desktop app on each computer.

unassigned.title: Unassigned computers ({{count}})
unassigned.hint: Their recordings wait in quarantine until you assign them to a clinic.

assign.title: Assign computer to a clinic
assign.desc: Its recordings in quarantine move to the clinic you choose and are checked.
assign.descMove: The computer and its later recordings belong to the clinic you choose. Make sure it uses that clinic's access token.
assign.done: Computer assigned. Recordings released for checking: {{count}}.

rename.title: Rename computer
rename.label: Computer name
rename.help: Leave empty to show the computer's ID.

computers.title: Computers
computers.hint: Installations of the desktop app that use this clinic's token.
computers.hiddenHint: Waiting uploads are shown only to users assigned to this clinic.
computers.emptyBody: A computer appears here after the desktop app downloads its configuration with this clinic's access token.

connection.title: Connect a computer
connection.hint: Enter these in the desktop app under Settings.
connection.askAdmin: Ask your administrator for the access token.
connection.rotateWarning: Every computer using the old token stops receiving updates and cannot upload until you enter the new token on it.

studies.title: Studies running here
studies.readOnlyHint: You can review these studies' recordings.
studies.empty: No study runs at this clinic yet.
studies.receivedReason: Managed by its editors. You can review its recordings.
studies.addDesc: Its current protocols go to the computers here on their next refresh.
studies.nothingToAdd: All the studies you edit already run here.
studies.stopBody: The computers here no longer receive this study's protocols. Existing recordings stay.
studies.stopped: The study no longer runs here.

receives.title: What the computers receive
receives.hint: Current protocols of every study above. Computers refresh at start-up.
receives.empty: Nothing yet. Computers receive the current protocols of the studies running here.
receives.summary_one: {{count}} protocol · offered in the app's languages: {{languages}}
receives.summary_other: {{count}} protocols · offered in the app's languages: {{languages}}

settings.readOnly: Only an administrator or the person who created this clinic can change these settings.
settings.desktopHint: Sent to every computer at this clinic. A local change on a computer wins over these defaults.
settings.languagesAll: All languages the protocols exist in
settings.languagesHint: Leave all unchecked to offer every language the protocols exist in.
settings.micHint: Leave empty to use the computer's default microphone.
settings.gainHint: A whole number from 0 to 100. Leave empty to keep the computer's own level.
settings.useCalibration: Show the calibration screen before speech tasks
settings.enableEditor: Let the examiner adjust task boundaries after the protocol
